I replied to Hollis in #central-team. The only record of a deadline is Pree's 14 October post in that same channel, which says the signed order form for Tansley Parcel is due 25 August.

She didn't say which year. That date has already passed this year, so when she posted it I asked whether she meant August 2027 or a deadline that's already gone by. She hasn't answered yet.

I told Hollis to check the year with Pree before he updates the account sheet. I found no other record of the deadline.
